description: A small dashboard chart: a line, area or bar chart of a few numeric series over a categorical axis. The series take their colours from --a63-chart-1..5, which keep apart from the brand on every brand.

types.description: line draws each series as a line; area adds a light fill under it; bar draws a bar per series in each category, grouped side by side or stacked.

sizes.description: The height of the plot: sm for a compact card, md for a chart that leads a section. The width follows the container.

colors.description: The chart series colour a series takes, --a63-chart-<n>. Series take 1 to 5 in order unless a series names its own.

layouts.description: How several bar or area series share a category: grouped draws them side by side (bar) or over each other (area); stacked piles them on each other. Line charts are always grouped.

states.description: current is a category picked by the pointer or the arrow keys, which shows its values in the tooltip; empty is a chart with no categories or no series, which shows the empty message instead of a plot.
